subject: Kickoff: DePlot chart QA for the analytics suite
body:
Hi all,

Starting the DePlot workstream today. The pitch: DePlot translates a chart image into a linearized table in one shot, and once you have the table, any of our reasoning models can answer questions over it. That decomposition is what makes it a fit for chart QA in the analytics suite -- we do not need to fine-tune a giant multimodal model per dashboard.

Scope for this half: fine-tune from the released checkpoints (they are fully compatible with the Pix2Struct codebase, which saves us a rewrite), stand up an internal demo on Shipyard, and hit an LRB slot in late June.

Daniela owns feasibility and staffing; first checkpoint review May 8.

Anders
